posts.cooked:
Is it just me, or is TL Tachyon just crazy? Allowing all her teammates to draw a card every turn (more or less)....crazy. I just played a game with TL Tachyon, Bunker, and Haka, and we absolutely wiped the floor with Dawn; she never even got the chance to flip. Set up was crazy fast, as was charging up the Omni and Haka of Battle. Of course, TL wasn't all there offensively, but the support she provided more than made up for it.

Now of course, the team I had was heavily dependent on card draw, etc, but drawing more cards would benefit ANY hero.

Again, Team Leader Tachyon is just crazy.

posts.name: celette482
posts.cooked:
Oh, I played as grandpa legacy last night with my bf and I felt so useful. On the one hand, it kinda feels like cheating. On the other hand, he doesn't have as many cool things. He makes other people cool. (and yeah, sure AA is also all about the support, but when you've got a good set up, he's just chaining performs and accompanies and things are happening all over the place). So, you get the benefit to all the other characters (and their players) by making them feel awesome, but you lose out on your own awesomeness because you focus on helping others and being all inspiringly present.

BUT that is sooooooo within in the theme of the game, that i appreciate it on a meta-textual level. Legacy COULD spend his time dive-bombing things, but he's got 2-4 other people with him and, gosh darn it, they're heroic too. So he helps them instead. (and his player gets to take on his job and make everyone else look good)

So game-play wise, yes, he feels like cheating if you're just treating the game like a game. Experience-wise? He fits riiiight in. (Of course, we usually play more than one hero, and whoever gets legacy gets their next pick)
